## What changed

One sentence. If it needs two, it is probably two pull requests.

## Why

The problem this fixes or the capability it adds, with the issue number if there is one.

## How it was verified

- [ ] `npm test` is green (paste the summary line)

- [ ] Screenshot or clip for anything visual
